about_the_game:
Can you really trust your friend, or is he just waiting to push you off the cliff?
Monkey Jump is a physics-based multiplayer party platformer that mixes racing, betrayal, and teamwork—all in a single round. One moment you’re working side by side collecting bananas, the next you’re rivals trying to knock each other down. In the end, a single banana might cost you a friendship.

Team or rival?
Game modes shift every round—sometimes you’ll team up to grab bananas, sometimes everyone fights for themselves. Your role and strategy change with every match.

Chaotic courses
Springboards, swinging bridges, exploding traps, and unexpected twists—each match starts with a fresh layout, so no two runs are ever the same.

Customize and show off
Pick your costumes, colors, and style to bring your monkey to life and stand out on the stage.

More fun with friends
Play with 2–8 players online. Invite your friends, grow the chaos, and climb the leaderboards.

Features

  • Online party game for 2–8 players

  • Competitive and team-based modes

  • Dynamic, physics-driven obstacles

  • Character customization & costumes

  • High replayability

  • Global leaderboards

  • Detailed stats & match analysis

  • Map selection and random map mode
